I’m Frank Lucido, a highly skilled negotiator and results-driven real estate expert with a background in professional sales. I specialize in helping buyers and sellers navigate the ever-changing market with confidence, clarity, and a competitive edge. Whether you’re searching for the perfect home, selling for top dollar, or looking for strategic investment opportunities, I’m the guy who makes things happen.

Why Work With Me?

Unlike the typical realtor, I bring decades of high-level sales experience to the table, ensuring my clients get the best deal possible—without the stress. My negotiation skills were honed in the competitive world of automotive sales, where every dollar and detail mattered. Now, I apply that expertise to real estate, making sure my clients win, whether they’re buying or selling.

I don’t just list houses—I market them with precision. From leveraging an omnichannel social media strategy to tapping into psychological principles that drive buyer demand, my approach creates urgency and delivers results. I understand what makes people take action, and I craft compelling marketing that positions your home ahead of the competition.

The Lucido Difference

  • Expert Negotiation — I make sure you get the best price, terms, and deal possible.
  • Cutting-Edge Marketing — Social media, targeted ads, strategic content—your home gets seen.
  • No Pressure, Just Guidance — You make the decisions. I provide the insights, strategy, and execution.
  • Unmatched Local Knowledge — As a lifelong Michigan native, I know the market inside and out.
  • A Personal Touch — I treat every deal as if it were my own. Your success is my priority.

Beyond Real Estate

Proud father of 5 & husband of 27 years. I’m a lifelong Detroit Red Wings fan, a competitive spirit, and an unapologetically proud Italian who values honesty, hard work, and a good laugh. Whether we’re talking business, sports, or strategy, you’ll always get direct, no-BS advice from me.

If you want a trusted advisor who makes real estate simple, smart, and wildly successful, let’s talk.
